fields: cols [who writes the limit, what it sets, what to send, where it applies], rows (cells strings or {t, link}). The tab is the writer up to its first number (ASTM D1193-24), else its first word.
best_for: LimitDrawer shows who writes each limit and what to send them as a file drawer: one manila folder per limit-writer, its tab at its own cut position so no tab hides another, what the limit sets on the folder, a clipped white slip listing what to send, and a navy index label naming where it applies.

block.intro: Outside drugs and natural health products, no regulator sets a Purified Water grade for these uses. Your recipe, your process or your equipment maker sets the limit.
